answer: Every identity earns nectar from its own spend history: the vault stores a hash-chained log of the counterparties it paid, and the ledger cross-checks these graphs before paying. A clone lacks a unique spend path, so its nectar stays zero until it generates real flow. Forging flow means burning balance with twenty distinct counterparties per fake identity; cost scales linearly, since shared spend edges expose the cluster to slashing at dawn.
